answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the quill forfeiture shows up in the relic totals with the tundra audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 14% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 213 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
